name: North Ayrshire
title: North Ayrshire —
title_em: Arran, Largs and the Clyde coast.
tagline: The Isle of Arran, Largs and the shores of the Firth of Clyde.
summary: North Ayrshire includes the Isle of Arran, known as Scotland in miniature, and the Cumbrae islands, with Largs, Saltcoats and Irvine on the mainland.
The Battle of Largs in 1263 ended Norse rule in the Hebrides, and Arran's Goat Fell, castle and distillery draw visitors.
